facts.text: Evan started watercolor painting a few years before the session on 18 May 2023.

evidence.quote: I started doing this a few years back.

facts.text: Evan introduced Sam to watercolor painting and provided some initial advice.

evidence.quote: My friend got me into it and gave me some advice, and I was hooked right away!

facts.text: Sam expressed hope of finding a passion similar to Evan's enthusiasm for watercolor painting.

evidence.quote: I hope I can find something I'm as passionate about as you are with watercolor painting.

facts.text: Evan encouraged Sam to keep trying new things in order to discover a passion.

evidence.quote: You'll find it, just keep trying new things until something sparks your excitement.
